About the Team
Our Trust & Safety, Integrity and Fraud Product team is dedicated to ensuring a safe and trusted experience for all customers across our platform, including Consumers, Merchants, and Dashers. We tackle complex challenges, from preventing fraud and ATO to ensuring authenticity, to building regulatory compliance capabilities, all while balancing risk mitigation and providing a seamless user experience. Our team partners closely with cross-functional groups, including Engineering, Data Science, Compliance, and Risk Operations, to drive strategic initiatives that protect our business while fostering growth.
About the Role
The DoorDash marketplace is expanding rapidly beyond just restaurants as we become “your door to more." As we add new products, geographies, ways for Dashers to earn, as well as use cases to help consumers save time, we’re expanding and enhancing our fraud capabilities to be best in the industry at keeping our platform safe and trustworthy. We strongly believe that trust is the most important attribute of an online marketplace, and the team ensures that we maintain this trust.
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager that will lead dedicated cross-functional teams to solve complex challenges that impact Consumers, Dashers and Merchants and touch every corner of our business - from new user onboarding, to the in-app dashing experience, to the products and services being created that our users can’t find anywhere else. We are looking to hire for a few roles, so you’ll either lead a vertical fraud team protecting Consumers or lead a horizontal fraud platform team focused on building our Risk Engine, Data Signals Intelligence and Automation / Anomaly Detection capabilities. The Fraud team is in hyper growth in terms of its size and impact and offers a unique opportunity to set and execute on a vision that will shape the future of DoorDash.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Set the vision and long-term product strategy for one of our vertical fraud teams or our horizontal platform fraud team.
Develop and execute a customer-focused product roadmap through close collaboration with senior leadership, Operations, Data Science, Analytics, Design, and Engineering all while balancing business needs.
Translate customer and internal-user needs into clear, well-defined functional and technical requirements backed by data analysis and deep understanding of our users
Guide and interface closely with data analysis and engineering teams to define scope, review and refine technical capabilities, prioritize projects for release, and define new opportunities.
Build long-term instrumentation, monitoring, and evaluation capabilities for product performance, tracking, and to create product insights.
Establish business cases and projected return on investment to identify and prioritize opportunities
Partner with Finance and Business Leaders to manage the impact on the profitability of the overall business.
We’re excited about you because you have…
5+ years of product management experience in the tech industry
3 or more years of experience across Integrity/Trust & Safety/Fraud
Experience defining strategic vision and tactical execution in a given product area
Experience in iterative, agile software delivery, short release cycles
Focus and thoughtfulness on data and analytics to solve problems and experience achieving results through continuous improvement
Experience in effectively working with multiple teams for collaboration and company-wide project delivery
Tenacity to keep issues top of mind of relevant stakeholders and conviction to stand-by decisions
Time management skills and ability to prioritize independently
Bachelor or Master's degree in Computer Science or data-related domain
Must be comfortable regularly exercising discretion and independent judgment in performing job duties, including evaluating options, making informed decisions, and determining appropriate courses of action within the scope of assigned responsibilities.

Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.
In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.
DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

jobs.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team turns research breakthroughs into production-grade systems. We embed deeply with customers to solve high-leverage problems and act as the delivery engine for our most complex large-scale engagements. We move quickly from prototype to production and surface reusable patterns that shape our platform. We operate at the intersection of deployment and development – working closely with OpenAI Research, Product and Partnerships. About the Role This is a founding role. As EMEA’s first Deployment Lead (DL), you will define how OpenAI delivers complex systems to customers. You will own how they are built, shipped, and adopted. You’ll translate business outcomes into a technical plan, run day-to-day execution across FDEs, Researchers, and Customer Engineers, and partner with customer teams to ensure delivery supports their goals. You will own delivery end-to-end: embedding with customers to map workflows and success criteria, ensuring components ship on time, and leading readiness and change management for adoption. You’ll track progress, manage dependencies, make sequencing decisions, and drive 0→1 prototypes through MVP and scale. You will also share field insights with Product and Research to guide roadmap and priorities. Success will be measured first and foremost by impact - deployments that deliver measurable value against customer goals, drive adoption, and become critical to their workflows. Additional measures of success include delivery reliability (milestones hit, low reopen/churn), operating leverage (patterns reused across deployments), judgment under pressure, and product impact (field signal that shifts roadmaps/architectures). This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role. Success requires technical project management expertise, extreme ownership of outcomes, and an ability to immerse in customer workflows and partner with customer teams to solve complex engineering problems at pace. This role is based in Singapore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. In this role, you will: - Own the technical delivery plan for multiple interdependent workstreams. Translate business objectives into a roadmap with milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria. - Run day-to-day engineering execution. Track and drive delivery across OpenAI FDE and customer teams. Keep progress unblocked and sequenced. Make real-time trade-offs on scope and priority to protect the critical path. - Embed with customer teams to land production deployments and drive adoption. Map workflows, shape tools/integrations, and translate requirements into a delivery plan. Lead onboarding, adoption, and change management. - Partner with Product and Research so platform components and research workstreams land in time to support deployment goals. - Codify solution patterns and evals. Extract reusable patterns and package field signals to improve product and models. - Own value cases and ROI. Set impact hypotheses, baselines, and KPIs; run pre-/post-deployment measurement and report to exec sponsors. You’ll thrive in this role if you: - Bring 7+ years of customer‑facing technical delivery leadership. - Track record of successfully leading large, complex, high-stakes customer engagements where customer outcomes depended on tight coordination and fast decision making, ideally involving AI. - Excel in high ambiguity environments. Know how to simplify complex and dynamic work. - Move fluidly between system level understanding and execution level detail; can dive into customer workflows/data, map constraints, sketch architectures and move ambiguous problems to shipped systems. - Think strategically and pattern-match. Able to step back from execution detail, recognise broader trends across deployments, and connect customer needs to scalable, reusable solutions. - Have strong technical fluency and sharp sequencing instincts. Establish the support model and performance management with the system integration partner, manage resource allocations, define technical standards, and be the primary point of escalation. This is an exciting opportunity to join one of the global leaders in cell therapy. We need colleagues interested in change, in challenge and in building a new future together. Kite, A Gilead Company At Kite, we are at the forefront of immunotherapy and engineered T cell therapy. We are helping change the paradigm of cancer treatment and are revolutionizing individually tailored treatments. That means a fast moving and constantly changing environment, where we make discoveries every day – discoveries that include our own capabilities and individual potential. We’re seeking to recruit highly motivated talent to join our exciting mission, in the development of innovative cell therapies and their application to the treatment of patients with cancer. The Team You will be an integral and highly visible part of Kite’s global IT team. Your efforts will support the definition of a global IT strategy and accompanying roadmap for Kite’s mission of treating and curing cancer with cell therapy. Essential Duties and Job Functions General responsibilities for this position will include (but are not limited to) the following: Build trusted relationships with leaders and stakeholders across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Logistics, Quality, and Patient Operations; understand their priorities and translate business needs into technology strategies, roadmaps, and executable solutions. Lead cross-functional alignment across business, IT, vendors, and support organizations by facilitating decisions, clarifying priorities and trade-offs, and driving issues through resolution to achieve successful business outcomes. Own the health, stability, performance, and operational resilience of Kite Konnect Enterprise and Supply Chain platforms and integrations, including incident response, root cause analysis, corrective actions, service metrics, monitoring, and support governance. Lead integration and data-related activities across Oracle EBS, SAP, Salesforce, and downstream applications, including reliability, error handling, interoperability, data quality, migration, reconciliation, and master data governance. Provide directions to managed service providers, implementation partners, and support teams; manage priorities, backlog, resource planning, service delivery performance, SLAs, and partner accountability. Communicate system health, risks, incidents, project status, recommendations, and operational trends to leadership, business partners, vendors, and cross-functional teams. Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders, develop a strong understanding of operational priorities, and influence technology decisions as a strategic advisor. Strong business acumen and the ability to connect technology strategy, architecture, and delivery decisions to operational outcomes, patient impact, risk reduction, and measurable business value. Strong understanding of end-to-end supply chain, manufacturing, logistics, finance, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, inventory, warehouse management, and related life sciences business processes. Hands-on experience with migration, integration, and application delivery across platforms such as: Oracle EBS, SAP, Salesforce, Veeva, Sitecore, and downstream related systems. Strong technical knowledge of middleware platforms, APIs, web services, event-driven integrations, integration patterns, data transformation, reconciliation, data quality, and master data management. Experience with digital operations and support governance, including incident and problem management, ITIL service management, monitoring, operational reporting, root cause analysis, corrective actions, change and release management, environment management, and risk mitigation. Proven ability to lead solution design reviews, establish technical standards, oversee SDLC delivery, manage third-party vendors and global delivery partners, and drive outcomes in a matrixed organization. Strong systems thinking, analytical problem-solving, communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, influencing, project/portfolio management, ownership, accountability, and operational rigor. Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on operational execution, manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment, and communicate complex technology considerations, risks, options, and recommendations in clear business terms across technical, operational, and executive audiences. Significant relevant experience in commercial life science, pharmaceutical, or similarly regulated environment preferred; occasional travel to Kite/Gilead locations may be required. Consultative and collaborative, with the ability to listen, challenge constructively, build alignment, and influence outcomes without direct authority. Versatile - with the ability to deliver against a broad set of objectives and competing priorities concurrently. Consistent excellence in both planning and execution.
